verdict.rationale: Only community anecdotes show keyboard-driven use: typing in the Dash to launch apps (with a ranking annoyance), the Unity HUD for typing to find menu items, and WIN+SHIFT+arrow hotkeys to move windows between monitors. Most of this describes the older Unity/Compiz era rather than the current GNOME-based desktop, and no first-party documentation covers keyboard shortcuts or the launcher. missing for 10: first-party docs on keyboard shortcuts and custom hotkeys for the current desktop, evidence of keyboard-only window management such as tiling, workspaces and switching, evidence of the current launcher's keyboard workflow, independent hands-on confirmation that the entire system can be run keyboard-only.
